title: Functional calibration for trunk and lower limb fixed inertial sensors
author: Benedikt Fasel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.itrcem6

steps.title: Perform Slow Squats
steps.instruction: Stand with arms parallel to the legs, then slowly flex the knees, hips, trunk, and head until the fingers reach the ankles; repeat the full squat three times.

steps.title: Execute Slow Trunk Rotations
steps.instruction: With hips fixed, hold a ski pole horizontally behind the neck, turn the head together with the trunk around the vertical axis, starting by looking to the right; perform the rotation slowly three times.

steps.title: Hip Adduction/Abduction
steps.instruction: Using ski poles for balance, keep the right heel in line with the left toe, keep the knee straight, and perform slow hip abduction followed by adduction three times on the right leg, then repeat on the left leg; ensure the toes remain pointing forward with no external hip rotation. Practice the correct movement a few times before the calibration.

substeps.instruction: Practice the hip ad/abduction movement a few times to avoid external rotation.
Right leg: perform slow abduction and adduction three times.
Left leg: perform slow abduction and adduction three times.

steps.title: Static Upright Hold
steps.instruction: Stand upright with knees slightly flexed, weight evenly distributed on both feet, gaze straight ahead, and remain still for 10 seconds.
